findings.issue: Global configBusy lock covers slow preview/send requests and rejects concurrent pause/disconnect controls before they reach core.
findings.reproduction: Memory-only createBridgeServer on port 0 with a gated morningReport.create; POST /api/morning/preview pending, then POST /api/pause -> HTTP 409 CONFIG_BUSY.
findings.recommendation: Allow pause/disconnect controls to bypass slow-operation lock and retain authorization rechecks before outbound delivery.

findings.issue: MCP integration test binds the production port, preventing full tests while the live bot is running.
findings.recommendation: Isolate test transport with an injected loopback origin/port or test-only dependency, without exposing arbitrary destinations to public MCP arguments.

findings.issue: Test and current sender disagree on operation identity and repeat invocation semantics.
findings.recommendation: Document explicit repeated-send behavior separately from retrying an uncertain operation; align tests with that contract and preserve a stable operation key for retries.
